parts.title: Saving the Bittern
parts.article:
Saving the Bittern

A The bittern, a British waterbird, does not have a good record as far as survival is concerned. By 1886, habitat destruction and other pressures had pushed it close to extinction. Fortunately, it recovered a decade later, and in 1950 the numbers of male bitterns rose to a peak of about 70. By the 1980s, however, it was clear that the bird was in trouble again. The bittern needs extensive wet reedbeds to survive, and long periods of drainage, pollution and lack of management had destroyed most of its habitat. By 1997, it again faced imminent extinction. To prevent this, the British government set up a plan for the bittern, aiming to establish a population of 50 males by 2010. However, this target was reached six years early, a rate of recovery faster than anyone had dared hope for. The Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) now claims the bittern as one of Britain’s greatest wildlife success stories, since figures reveal that the number of these rare birds has increased fivefold in just seven years.

B Bitterns have feathers that help them to conceal themselves and a shy nature; they usually remain hidden within the cover of reedbed vegetation. Our first challenge was to develop standard methods to monitor their numbers. The booming call of the male bittern is its most distinctive feature during the breeding season, and we developed a method to count them using the sound patterns unique to each individual. This not only allowed us to estimate local survival of males from one year to the next.

C Our first direct understanding of what breeding bitterns require in their ideal habitat came from comparisons of reedbed sites that had lost their male birds with those that retained them. This research showed that bitterns had been retained in reedbeds where the natural process of drying out had been slowed through management. Based on this work, broad recommendations on how to manage and rehabilitate reedbeds for bitterns were made, and funding was provided through a European Union (EU) wildlife fund to manage 13 sites within the core breeding range.

D To refine these recommendations and provide fine-scale, quantitative habitat prescriptions on the bitterns’ preferred feeding habitat, we started radio-tracking male bitterns on the RSPB’s Minsmere and Leighton Moss reserves. This showed clear preferences for feeding in the wetter reedbed areas, particularly within reed next to larger open pools. The average home range sizes of the male bitterns we followed (about 20 hectares) provided a good indication of the area of reedbed necessary when managing or creating habitat for this species. Female bitterns undertake all the incubation and care of the young, so it was important to understand their requirements as well. Over the course of our research, we located 87 bittern nests and found that female bitterns preferred to nest in areas of continuous vegetation, well into the reedbed, but where water was still present during the driest part of the breeding season.

E The success of the habitat prescriptions developed from this research has been spectacular. For instance, at Minsmere, male bittern numbers gradually increased from one to ten following reedbed lowering, a management technique designed to halt the drying out process. After a low point of 11 mature males in 1997, bittern numbers in Britain responded to all the habitat management work and started to increase for the first time since 1950.

F The final phase of research involved understanding the diet, survival and dispersal of bittern chicks. To do this, we fitted small radio tags to young bittern chicks in the nest, to determine their fate through to fledging, when they begin to fly, and beyond. Many chicks did not survive to this stage, and starvation was found to be the most likely reason for their demise. The first prey fed to chicks were mainly those species penetrating into the reed edge. So, an important element of recent studies has been development of recommendations on habitat and water conditions to promote native fish populations. Once independent, radio-tagged young bitterns were found to seek out new sites during their first winter; a proportion of these would remain on new sites if the conditions were suitable. A second EU-funded project aims to provide these suitable sites in new areas. A network of 19 sites developed through this partnership project will secure a more sustainable UK bittern population with successful breeding outside of the core area, less vulnerable to chance and sea level rise.

G By 2004, the number of booming male bitterns in the UK had increased to 55. Almost all the increase occurred on those sites undertaking management based on advice from our research. While rescuing the bittern, the work has helped a range of other wetland species such as otters. Although science has been at the core of the recovery story, success has only been achieved through the trust, hard work and dedication of all the managers, owners and wardens of sites that have implemented, in some cases very drastic, management to secure the future of this wetland species in the UK.

analyses.content: 这段话完整描述了这种鸟类数量从回升到顶峰，再到面临灭绝的忽高忽低的历史变化过程，所以选 i。
你可能想选择 vii，但是这段话的重点不是讲述最初干预的结果，而是纵观整个历史阶段的数量起伏。

Fortunately, it recovered a decade later, and in 1950 the numbers of male bitterns rose to a peak of about 70. By the 1980s, however, it was clear that the bird was in trouble again. The bittern needs extensive wet reedbeds to survive, and long periods of drainage, pollution and lack of management had destroyed most of its habitat. By 1997, it again faced imminent extinction.
这段话的核心在于科学家们遇到了监测数量的挑战，并开发了通过叫声来“数清”这种鸟的具体方法，对应选项 viii。
你可能想选 ii，但这段并没有研究它们栖息地的需求，而是一直在讲如何计算它们的��量。

Our first challenge was to develop standard methods to monitor their numbers. The booming call of the male bittern is its most distinctive feature during the breeding season, and we developed a method to count them using the sound patterns unique to each individual. This not only allowed us to estimate local survival of males from one year to the next.
这段话讲了人们对栖息地最开始的初步调查比较，并据此做出了宏观的保护建议和决策，对应选项 v。
你可能想选 ii，但这只是初步的整体调查建议，还没有细化到成年鸟类的具体定量需求，所以选 v 更准确。

Our first direct understanding of what breeding bitterns require in their ideal habitat came from comparisons of reedbed sites that had lost their male birds with those that retained them. This research showed that bitterns had been retained in reedbeds where the natural process of drying out had been slowed through management. Based on this work, broad recommendations on how to manage and rehabilitate reedbeds for bitterns were made...
这段话详细且精细地研究了成年雄鸟（喂食偏好）和雌鸟（筑巢偏好）分别需要什么样的栖息环境，所以选 ii。
你可能想选 v，但这已经是进一步的精细化研究了，不再是初步（Initial）调查。

To refine these recommendations and provide fine-scale, quantitative habitat prescriptions on the bitterns’ preferred feeding habitat, we started radio-tracking male bitterns... Female bitterns undertake all the incubation and care of the young, so it was important to understand their requirements as well. Over the course of our research, we located 87 bittern nests and found that female bitterns preferred to nest in areas of continuous vegetation...
这段开篇就直接定调，强调之前的栖息地保护措施取得了极其惊人的成功，鸟类数量开始显著回升，完美对应 vii。
你可能想选 i，但这段只讲了数量单向上升的成功结果，并没有讲数量起伏波动（Fluctuations）。

The success of the habitat prescriptions developed from this research has been spectacular. For instance, at Minsmere, male bittern numbers gradually increased from one to ten... After a low point of 11 mature males in 1997, bittern numbers in Britain responded to all the habitat management work and started to increase for the first time since 1950.
这段话重点研究了幼鸟的食物（本土鱼类），强调了食物供应在自然生态中对它们生存的重要性，对应 iv。
你可能想选 iii，但文中提到幼鸟死亡主要是因为饿死（starvation）而不是被自然界中的捕食者（Predators）吃掉。

Many chicks did not survive to this stage, and starvation was found to be the most likely reason for their demise. The first prey fed to chicks were mainly those species penetrating into the reed edge. So, an important element of recent studies has been development of recommendations on habitat and water conditions to promote native fish populations.
这段话结尾明确指出，这种鸟类的成功恢复离不开所有管理者、所有者和管理员的共同信任与努力合作，对应 vi。
你可能想选 ix，但文中只是提到了科学研究和多方合作，并没有提到教育（Education）是保护野生动物的关键。

Although science has been at the core of the recovery story, success has only been achieved through the trust, hard work and dedication of all the managers, owners and wardens of sites that have implemented, in some cases very drastic, management to secure the future of this wetland species in the UK.

analyses.content: 原文明确提到这种鸟的数量在1950年达到了顶峰（peak），这也就是数量最大的时候。
你可能想选 1886 或 1997，但这两个年份是它们濒临灭绝（close to extinction）的低谷期，完全相反。
Fortunately, it recovered a decade later, and in 1950 the numbers of male bitterns rose to a peak of about 70.
原文直接用“shy nature”来形容这种鸟类的天性（character），所以答案就是 shy。
你可能想填 hidden，但 hidden 描述的是它们躲藏起来的动作状态，而真正形容性格特征的词只有 shy。
Bitterns have feathers that help them to conceal themselves and a shy nature; they usually remain hidden within the cover of reedbed vegetation.
原文明确指出，饥饿（starvation）是导致这些幼鸟死亡（demise）最可能的原因。
你可能想凭常识猜测是捕食者（predators），但原文强调它们其实是死于饥饿。
Many chicks did not survive to this stage, and starvation was found to be the most likely reason for their demise.
原文提到为了幼鸟的食物，最近的研究重点是促进本地鱼类（fish）的繁殖，说明幼鸟依赖鱼类作为食物来源。
你可能想填 prey，但 prey 只是“猎物”的泛称，题目问的是依赖的具体食物，紧接着提到的 fish 才是准确答案。

The first prey fed to chicks were mainly those species penetrating into the reed edge. So, an important element of recent studies has been development of recommendations on habitat and water conditions to promote native fish populations.
原文直白地提到，保护这种鸟类的工作也连带帮助了其他湿地物种，比如水獭（otters）。
你可能想填 fish，但鱼类在文中是作为幼鸟的食物被培育的，而真正和这种鸟类一样作为“其他物种”被保护并受益的是 otters。
While rescuing the bittern, the work has helped a range of other wetland species such as otters.

analyses.content: 全文采用典型的“提出问题-研究方案-解决问题”结构，主旨句明确总结了科学研究（research/science）和有效管理（good management）是如何拯救濒危物种的。
你可能会被选项 C（对抗湿地芦苇荡的破坏）吸引，但这只是具体执行的管理手段之一，无法概括全文强调“科研指导管理并取得全方位成功”的宏观主旨。

Although science has been at the core of the recovery story, success has only been achieved through the trust, hard work and dedication of all the managers, owners and wardens... to secure the future of this wetland species in the UK.
